clues.text: Samson found a swarm of bees in a lion's carcass and scooped this out to eat.
After forty days spying out Canaan, the men told Moses the land truly flowed with milk and this.
Preaching in the wilderness of Judea, John the Baptist, dressed in camel's hair, lived on this, found wild.
In the law of grain offerings, this, like leaven, was never to be burned as a food offering to the LORD.
Sending his sons back to Egypt, Israel had them carry balm, spices, myrrh, pistachios, almonds, and a little of this.
Jeroboam told his disguised wife to take loaves, cakes, and a jar of this to the prophet Ahijah at Shiloh.
A psalm says the LORD's judgments are more precious than gold and sweeter than this from the comb.
